COUNT SPANNING TREE
• Given a undirected connected graph G = (V,E) in which
V = {1,…,N} is the set of nodes. Count the number of spanning trees of G.
• There are 8 spanning trees represented by list of
edges as follows
• (1,2) (1,3) (1,4)

• (1,3) (1,4) (2,3)
• (1,3) (2,3) (3,4)
